verses.original: בְּךָֽ־ יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ אֵב֥וֹשָׁה
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā- Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh
verses.literal: In You O LORD I have taken refuge let me never . . . be put to shame

verses.original: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־ אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ אֵלַ֥י וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā taṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ū·ṯə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî haṭ·ṭêh- ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ’ê·lay wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: In Your justice rescue and deliver me incline Your ear - and save me

verses.original: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן תָּמִ֗יד לָב֗וֹא צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ אָֽתָּה׃ סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י
verses.transliteration: hĕ·yêh lî lə·ṣūr mā·‘ō·wn tā·mîḏ lā·ḇō·w ṣiw·wî·ṯā lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî kî- ’āt·tāh sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: Be . . . my rock of refuge where I can always go Give the command to save me for You are my rock and my fortress

verses.original: פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
verses.transliteration: pal·lə·ṭê·nî ’ĕlō·hay mî·yaḏ rā·šā‘ mik·kap̄ mə·‘aw·wêl wə·ḥō·mēṣ
verses.literal: Deliver me O my God from the hand of the wicked from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ṯiq·wā·ṯî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh miḇ·ṭa·ḥî min·nə·‘ū·rāy
verses.literal: For You are my hope O Lord GOD my confidence from my youth

verses.original: נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי עָלֶ֤יךָ׀ מִבֶּ֗טֶן אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י אִ֭מִּי מִמְּעֵ֣י תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃ בְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: nis·maḵ·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā mib·be·ṭen ’at·tāh ḡō·w·zî ’im·mî mim·mə·‘ê ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ṯā·mîḏ bə·ḵā
verses.literal: I have leaned on You since birth You pulled me from my mother’s womb My praise is always for You

verses.original: הָיִ֣יתִי כְּ֭מוֹפֵת לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה עֹֽז׃ מַֽחֲסִי־
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî kə·mō·w·p̄êṯ lə·rab·bîm wə·’at·tāh ‘ōz ma·ḥă·sî-
verses.literal: I have become a portent to many but You are my strong refuge

verses.original: פִ֭י יִמָּ֣לֵא תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃ כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם
verses.transliteration: p̄î yim·mā·lê tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā tip̄·’ar·te·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: My mouth is filled [with] Your praise [and with] Your splendor all day long

verses.original: אַֽל־ תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה אַֽל־ תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃ כֹּ֝חִ֗י כִּכְל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’al- taš·lî·ḵê·nî lə·‘êṯ ziq·nāh ’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî kō·ḥî kiḵ·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not discard me . . . in my old age do not forsake me when my strength fails

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָמְר֣וּ לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·wy·ḇay ’ā·mə·rū lî wə·šō·mə·rê nap̄·šî nō·w·‘ă·ṣū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: For my enemies speak against me and those who lie in wait for my life conspire . . .

verses.original: לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ă·zā·ḇōw riḏ·p̄ū wə·ṯip̄·śū·hū kî- ’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: saying God has forsaken him pursue him and seize him for there is no one to rescue him

verses.original: אַל־ תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֭לֹהִים חִישָׁה׃ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי
verses.transliteration: ’al- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥī·šå̄h ’ĕ·lō·hay lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Be not far from me O God Hurry O my God to help me

verses.original: שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃ יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה
verses.transliteration: śō·ṭə·nê nap̄·šî yê·ḇō·šū yiḵ·lū mə·ḇaq·šê rā·‘ā·ṯî ya·‘ă·ṭū ḥer·pāh ū·ḵə·lim·māh
verses.literal: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed [and] consumed may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃ וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־ כָּל־
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî tā·mîḏ ’ă·ya·ḥêl tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·hō·w·sap̄·tî ‘al- kāl-
verses.literal: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more

verses.original: פִּ֤י׀ יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pî yə·sap·pêr ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā tə·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî sə·p̄ō·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long . . . though I cannot know their full measure

verses.original: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇō·w biḡ·ḇu·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’az·kîr ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ḇad·de·ḵā
verses.literal: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD I will proclaim Your righteousness Yours alone

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־ הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm lim·maḏ·ta·nî min·nə·‘ū·rāy wə·‘aḏ- hên·nāh ’ag·gîḏ nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: O God You have taught me from my youth and to this day . . . I proclaim Your marvelous deeds

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם עַד־ זִקְנָ֨ה׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אַֽל־ תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֪ים עַד־ אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃ לְכָל־ יָ֝ב֗וֹא
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ‘aḏ- ziq·nāh wə·śê·ḇāh ’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘aḏ- ’ag·gîḏ zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā lə·ḏō·wr gə·ḇū·rā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ḵāl yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: Even when I am old and gray do not forsake me O God until I proclaim Your power to the next generation Your might to all who are to come

verses.original: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ עַד־ מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת מִ֣י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ‘aḏ- mā·rō·wm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ mî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḵā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Your righteousness [reaches] to the heavens O God You who have done great things Who O God is like You

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִרְאִיתַנוּ רַבּ֗וֹת צָר֥וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תְּחַיֵּינוּ תָּשׁ֥וּב וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃ תָּשׁ֥וּב
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hir·ʾī·ṯa·nū rab·bō·wṯ ṣā·rō·wṯ wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ tə·ḥay·yē·nū tā·šūḇ ū·mit·tə·hō·mō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ta·‘ă·lê·nî tā·šūḇ
verses.literal: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes You will revive me once again Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up

verses.original: תֶּ֤רֶב׀ גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃ וְתִסֹּ֥ב
verses.transliteration: te·reḇ gə·ḏul·lā·ṯî tə·na·ḥă·mê·nî wə·ṯis·sōḇ
verses.literal: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֤י׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־ נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî ’ō·wḏ·ḵā ḇiḵ·lî- ne·ḇel ’ă·mit·tə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hāy ’ă·zam·mə·rāh lə·ḵā ḇə·ḵin·nō·wr qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So I will praise You with the harp . . . for Your faithfulness O my God I will sing praise to You with the lyre O Holy One of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־ לָּ֑ךְ שְׂ֭פָתַי תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·zam·mə·rāh- lāḵ śə·p̲ā·t̲ai tə·ran·nên·nāh wə·nap̄·šî ’ă·šer pā·ḏî·ṯā
verses.literal: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy along with my soul which You have redeemed

verses.original: לְשׁוֹנִ֗י תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה גַּם־ צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם כִּי־ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃ בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־ חָ֝פְר֗וּ
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·w·nî teh·geh gam- ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm kî- mə·ḇaq·šê rā·‘ā·ṯî ḇō·šū ḵî- ḥā·p̄ə·rū
verses.literal: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long . . . for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded
